polaroidQuote0: If there was one type of weather you could ban on Earth...which would it be?
polaroidQuote1: Some days I just want to pack my favorite swimsuit and go on a loooong vacation somewhere warm and cozy!
polaroidQuote2: There are some days when I just need sun, the beach and a cocktail...Someone give me a holiday!
polaroidQuote3: I love taking pictures when I travel! I always bring my camera with me everywhere I go.
polaroidQuote4: Who is your favorite person to travel with in the whole world???
polaroidQuote5: If you were alone on a deserted island, what are the 3 things you couldn't live without?
polaroidQuote6: I love taking polaroids because I put the photos on my fridge and I can always see my beautiful memories!
polaroidQuote7: The biggest challenge is choosing where to go on my next holiday: to climb a mountain or relax on the beach!
polaroidQuote8: Some people want to see all the museums...others just want to visit coffee shops and buy souvenirs! Which type are you?
polaroidQuote9: Are you the kind of traveler that explores or relaxes? I love exploring an entirely new city!
polaroidQuote10: If you could take a plane to any location on Earth, where would you end up going?
polaroidQuote11: If I gave you one plane ticket and a ready suitcase, would you go on a vacation right now?
polaroidQuote12: Don't you always pack too many clothes when you travel? You never know when you need that beautiful dress you've never worn before!
